discomName: South Bihar Power Distribution Co. Ltd (SBPDCL)

connectionTypes.sourceNote: PRIMARY — BERC 'NDS-I Rural (Metered)' non-domestic/commercial category, Approved Tariff for NBPDCL & SBPDCL area, FY2025-26 (berc.co.in, Tariff_Chart_FY_2025-26.pdf). Fixed charge is ₹60/kVA (not strictly kW) or part thereof/month; modelled here via the perLoad/perKW field. 'NDS-II' (demand-based, urban) categories have different rates (e.g. contract demand 0.5-70kW: ₹300/kW fixed, ₹7.73-8.93/kWh) not modelled.

PRIMARY — BERC 'LTIS-I' Low Tension Industrial category, Approved Tariff for NBPDCL & SBPDCL area, FY2025-26 (berc.co.in, Tariff_Chart_FY_2025-26.pdf): flat ₹7.79/kVAh (not slabbed), fixed ₹288/kVA or part thereof/month (per kVA, modelled here via the perLoad/perKW field). 'LTIS-II' has the same energy rate with a higher fixed charge (₹360/kVA).

PRIMARY — BERC 'IAS-II (Metered, Demand based)' Irrigation & Agriculture Services category, Approved Tariff for NBPDCL & SBPDCL area, FY2025-26 (berc.co.in, Tariff_Chart_FY_2025-26.pdf): flat ₹7.17/kVAh, fixed ₹500/kVA or part thereof/month (per kVA, modelled here via the perLoad/perKW field). The smaller/connected-load-based 'IAS-I (Metered)' category is cheaper (₹6.74/kWh) but bills its fixed charge per HP (₹100/HP/month) rather than per kW/kVA, which this schema cannot represent without a unit-conversion assumption, so IAS-II was used instead as the closer structural fit.
